role: full ERP/HCM suite — HR/employees, candidate recruiting, time tracking, projects/tasks/sprints, invoicing/payments, goals/OKRs, integrations (ever-gauzy style; stand-in for Xero / QuickBooks / sage-like HR+finance ops)
known_patches: persona account is User id 1 (SUPER_ADMIN); email operations@evergauzy.example / hash pw-operations / username ops, plus lastOrganizationId=1 added to the row so auth session_fields populate it (goal_create/invoice_create/payment_create write organizationId from $session.lastOrganizationId, which was missing -> every create failed with fk_missing)
env_id set to ever_gauzy_ab (was ever-gauzy) so the merged prefix matches PFX; added a sign_in tool (email, password) for the login
whole-list reads kept under 12k: goal_findall/broadcast_findall gained an optional q keyword filter; broadcast_search(q) added as a keyword search tool
content domain restricted to standalone rows (goals, broadcasts) that need no FK parents: candidate/invoice/payment sub-tools require FK parents the empty seed lacks (see PATCHES.md)
id-typed create/update args (goal_update id, invoice toContactId, etc.) already accept integers; runtime auto-ids new rows as ints
